answer: Last month a farm cleared 400 clones through a single attestation pool in 9 hours. The fix is key rotation bound to work: one session key per completed task, revoked by one upheld challenge within 30 minutes. Numbers: 400 clones x 1 bond x 1 replay check = 400 unpaid bonds and 400 revocation windows. A quartz-standard audit costs 12 minutes per identity. The attacker's break-even moves from 3 days to 41 days. A haven of idle clones produces no keys, so no ripple of reciprocity forms, and the farm stays at zero.
